footer: CleanJibe takes the original FIT of every windsurf, wing, kite, surf and SUP activity in your intervals.icu account. It goes two years back.
Activities already in the library are never downloaded again.
sections.lead: Your sessions arrive by themselves, from any watch that syncs there.
sections.title: intervals.icu

footer: Strava opens, you say yes, and CleanJibe can list your activities on the Import screen.
CleanJibe only reads your Strava account. It never writes, renames or posts anything.
A session imported this way is analysed from your track alone, so its speed records are marked uncertified.
Strava lets a new app connect a limited number of riders. Connecting is refused while CleanJibe is full.
That says nothing about your account.
sections.lead: Bring in the sessions you already have on Strava. CleanJibe only reads them.
sections.title: Strava

footer:
While the phone is idle, CleanJibe asks intervals.icu for new activity.

It looks for windsurf, wing, kite, surf and SUP, from any watch that syncs there.

You hear about the ones that are not in your library yet.

The session is downloaded and analysed in the background, so tapping the notification usually opens a finished analysis.
sections.lead: Hear about a new session while the phone is idle.
sections.title: Notifications

sections.lead: Say which way your turns usually go, so a flat day still reads right.
sections.title: Analysis

footer: The speedsurfing world reads speed in knots. Pick km/h if that is the number you think in.
sections.lead: Read speeds in knots or in km/h.
sections.title: Units

footer: Verified means your watch measured the speed with Doppler.
Unverified means CleanJibe worked it out from positions. That reads high.
Prefer verified fills a row with an unverified record only when no verified one exists.
sections.lead: Choose whether records from tracks without measured speed count.
sections.title: Speed records

footer: Each row carries three numbers, each with its own word under it.
The track can be drawn over a map of the water it was ridden on. The map style is the one your session maps use.
sections.lead: Pick the three numbers each row shows, and whether the water is drawn behind its track.
sections.title: Session list

sections.lead: How much room your library takes, and a way to analyse it all again.
sections.title: Storage

footer: Setting up a new iPhone from this one carries your library across by itself, and so does an iCloud backup.
This is for the case neither covers: a phone set up as new, or the app deleted and installed again.
The file holds every recording you have imported and what nothing else can bring back.
That is session names, captions, riders, gear, spot names, and the sessions you deleted on purpose.
sections.lead: One file that holds every session and everything you typed on it.
sections.title: Library backup

footer: Your saved sessions live in this browser's own private storage.
They are not synced, not backed up and not visible to any other site.
Clearing this site's data, or using a private window, deletes them.
Download all gives you one zip. Restore from a backup reads that same file back.
sections.lead: What this browser holds, a copy you keep, and the way to wipe it.
sections.title: Your data

footer: Sessions you deleted stay deleted. Every sync of intervals.icu leaves them alone, by hand or in the background.
Restoring forgets that. The next sync brings back every one of them that is still on intervals.icu.
sections.lead: Put back a session you deleted.
sections.title: Deleted sessions

footer: Wind is estimated on this device from your track.
sections.lead: What is running here, and where the privacy policy is.
sections.title: About
